resolvedDefaults.text: The 30-day sub-1R exit fills at the next 00:00 UTC open minus s_bt.
The 10-day exit's next open is the 15m bar that opens at 00:00 UTC.
B's signal is the Sunday-dated daily bar that closes Monday 00:00. The entry is Monday 01:00.
B's held-set exit fills at the Monday 01:00 open minus s_bt.
A's 10-day exit is first evaluated at the first daily close after the entry date. The lookback still uses the prior 10 daily closes, including days before the entry.
Beta-weighted notional is the sum of max(beta, 0) times notional. A negative beta does not offset long exposure.
A name with fewer than 60 return days takes that month's highest signed member beta. If no member has a beta, the fallback is 1. The cap is never skipped.
After the stop moves, exit cost is one taker leg, 90 plus s_bt, on units times the current stop.
The $1,200 class backstop is the drawdown from the class peak cumulative net dollars, alongside the 20R kill.
The pair backstop is that pair's equity, realized net plus the open mark, at or below -$500.
Daily and weekly halt losses are the drop from equity at the UTC day start and at Monday 00:00.
Average linkage merges two clusters only when every member pair has a 60-day rho and the mean is at least 0.80. An equal mean merges the lexicographically earliest pair of cluster ids.
The $20 paper minimum applies to a null or non-positive lower-80% Kelly bound. A small positive fraction may size below $20.

Pauses may shrink a class to $20 and, for 2b, block new entries. The 1d kill, the 20R kill, and the dollar backstops stop the class at any size. Flag-only at $20 applies to pauses only. Breadth does not resize or block.
SPRT is report-only. Wald bounds are plus or minus ln 4. H0 is +0.25R and H1 is 0. The realized-sigma path and the 1.5R path are both reported. It never acts.
The 2b block is 14 calendar dates beginning on the condition date.
G2 concurrency is measured in the post-hash rerun. The pre-hash field stays empty.

Breadth state uses entry-day membership, the prior close, and hysteresis. It starts off. A share from 25 percent through 35 percent keeps the prior state. Option (c) logs the state and does not use it.
